title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1540: Feel the shock! (3)

section.p: Outside the tunnel, Xing Yue coldly said, “Interesting. That looks like the real Culture King’s token, but its grade is quite low.”
Xing Yue asked, “He Tu, did you sense anything earlier?”
He Tu.

That was an even more terrifying name. Liu Hong was losing his mind. He Tu, the target of the myriad races, was here as well? Xing Yue, He Tu, Su Yu…and another death spirit who also felt incredibly strong. Just what was going on here?

He Tu smiled and said, “That does feel like the Culture King’s token. How interesting. Is this a descendant of the Culture King? Or is this someone from one of the lines under the Culture King back then? Not everyone can put Culture King’s tokens to use. Su Yu, do you know this man?”
With a wide smile on his face, Su Yu said, “Yes. This is my beloved teacher. He taught me a lot, such as the art of scheming.”
Liu Hong was completely stunned. His mind was blanking out from the sheer fear he was feeling.
Holy shit!
Just where was this?

Was this really the Death Realm? No, right? Su Yu was here. He was walking around with several death sovereigns. Was this really happening? Liu Hong suspected that he had gone mad. He was probably seeing things. He asked, “Su Yu, are you dead?”
“Teacher Liu, you’ll probably die before me.”

Su Yu laughed without removing his hand from Liu Hong’s shoulder. “Teacher Liu, I have a lot of respect for you. Tell me. What are you doing here? How did you get this token? Also, I promised to let you go after returning. What’s the rush? Are you looking down on me? Or are you unhappy with the treatment I gave you?”
Liu Hong felt like crying. “Are you still alive?”
If he were still alive, what was happening here? Why was he hanging out with death sovereigns? This was too scary. Did he return through the Death Realm?
Heavens!

Liu Hong didn’t know what to say anymore. Su Yu was able to traverse all the way back from the Luminous Domain Mansion through the Death Realm. This signified that there was an unknown exit somewhere. What a terrifying guy. How did he do this?
Liu Hong was feeling shocked, helpless, and hopeless. He felt as though his life was over. He would never escape this kid.
With boundless despair in his eyes, he pitifully said, “I’m not trying to leave. Not at all. I’m only here to take a look at the Death Realm. I’m curious.”

Su Yu smiled, “Curious? Ahh, I have a good idea. Recently, Lord Xing Yue has been planning to call for a gathering of death sovereigns. Dozens of nearby death sovereigns will be invited. Since a living being is very rare down here, perhaps my Teacher Liu can serve as the main course during the feast. Such fresh food is very rare here. The death sovereigns will enjoy this.”
Su Yu said, “After all, this is an envoy of Culture King. He must taste nice.”

Liu Hong said with fear, “No, don’t do that! Su Yu, there is no quarrel between us! Remember how I helped you when you were weak? Also, I helped you by pretending to be you when you were away! Even now, nobody is sure if you’re in the mansion. Su Yu, I took a large risk helping you with this! I could have left earlier and you wouldn’t have encountered me here! Am I right?”

Su Yu gave Liu Hong a deep stare before saying, “Fine. But as a living being, stay away from the Death Realm. Return with me, Teacher. Stay in the mayor’s residence for a few days before leaving. Lord Xing Yue, please get someone to guard the tunnel. If he tries to come down again, do as you wish to him.”
Xing Yue said, “I’ll take watch personally.”
“Thank you, Lord.”
Su Yu said nothing else and walked forth while dragging Liu Hong with him. Xing One and the other death spirits moved aside respectfully as he walked past.
He was their new chief commander.
He was a big shot.
He was very strong.
He could easily handle eight Pseudo Invincibles alone. They were glad to serve such a powerful chief commander.

Meanwhile, Liu Hong had a look of despair and helplessness. How unlucky! How did he encounter Su Yu here? He could try to fool death sovereigns with Culture King’s token, but nothing worked against Su Yu.
After all, Su Yu was an even bigger schemer than him. Su Yu would not buy any of his words. More importantly, he had lost his Culture King’s token. He felt like crying.
Liu Hong kept staring at Su Yu’s pocket, wondering if he could take his token back. How pitiful of him.
As Su Yu walked, his death qi scattered. Before long, he became the old Su Yu with his fluttering white robes. There was only a small difference. He looked a lot more ethereal than before.
After a short moment, he stepped out of the tunnel with a smile on his face.
Instantly, someone appeared before him. It was Grandstar. He sighed and said, “You…sure are incredible.”
How did the kid return so smoothly? Did he handle Xing Yue as well? How impressive.
Su Yu smiled, “You praise me too much, Lord. This is no big deal.”
No big deal?
Grandstar didn’t even know what to say. Was this really not a big deal?
“You have grown much stronger than before.”
Grandstar said, “Every time I look at you, I feel like I have wasted all my life.”
He looked at Liu Hong and said, “I warned you, but you refused to believe me.”
Liu Hong still felt like crying. He believed Grandstar now. But it was too late.
After casually tossing Liu Hong aside, Su Yu said, “Lord, this is a big deal. He might even be a descendant of Culture King.”
“That’s not possible.” Grandstar shook his head, “Culture King had no descendants. He used to have some legacies left behind, but the legacies have been severed.”
Liu Hong hurriedly explained, “I’m not. I was merely lucky enough to pick up a token somewhere. Su Yu, you can keep the token. I—”
Su Yu couldn’t be bothered to say much. He sealed Liu Hong with a casual wave of his hand.
“Just stay here and think about life for a bit. I hope you can be honest by the time I’m done with my other task. You can try to lie again if you believe you can really fool me, Teacher.”
Su Yu said, “I’ll give you sufficient time to make up a believable lie. Make sure it’s a good lie. Otherwise, I won’t mind making you the main course of the death sovereigns during their feast.”
“Feast of sovereigns?”
Grandstar looked at Su Yu curiously. What was that?
Su Yu explained, “I had Xing Yue call for a gathering between all the nearby death sovereigns. What do you think about it, Lord?”
Grandstar’s expression changed massively.
He stared at Su Yu for a long while before saying, “Do it at Heavendoom’s place.”
Why must they do it here?
Holy shit!
Were they trying to kill him?
Was this a joke? They should do it at Heavendoom’s place instead, not here. Just look at how energetic Heavendoom was. He even had spare energy to pick fights with death spirits every now and then.

Su Yu grinned and said, “Don’t worry. I made it clear. It will only be a gathering. They won’t be attacking the tunnel. It will be fine. My people are down there. I made some good friends down here this time. By the way, He Tu is here as well. I’m tight with him as well.”
Grandstar gave Su Yu a deep stare.
Was that a threat? Perhaps. In a way.

Su Yu…had finally gained a solid power base. In the past, he was completely helpless. The guardians could decide for themselves if they wanted to help him. He couldn’t do anything about it. He could only passively accept all the death qi sent his way by the guardians. In short, he was the disadvantaged party in his dealings with the guardians.
But now…he had invited dozens of death sovereigns over.
Su Yu bowed slightly and said, “My apologies for troubling you lately, Lord. Now, I have gained a tiny bit of strength. I will do my best to relieve all of you.”

Su Yu solemnly said, “All guardians are charged with the task of guarding the death tunnels. I guarantee that with me around, all death tunnels will be unbreakable. That will only change upon my death.”

In short, his death might result in a disaster. Grandstar stared at Su Yu. The cautious and timid Su Yu had finally gained enough strength to be direct with him. Grandstar blanked out slightly. It hadn’t even been that long since Su Yu became a mayor.

After some time, he smiled and said, “The guardians only care about the laws. We are fine with anything as long as it helps with our task. As for the things unrelated to our task, we wouldn’t care even if the Myriad Realms were to fall.”
“Thank you, Lord.”
Su Yu cupped his hands and bowed to show his gratitude.

Grandstar smiled, “It’s fine. The guardians have been feeling quite bored over the years. A little bit of change isn’t bad. If someone can defeat the laws, we will be more than happy to let go of our task.”
He smiled bitterly and said, “Nobody wants to be a statue for a hundred thousand years. Would we have bothered if there were any other choices?”
Defying the laws? If the kid had the ability to do so, good. They would be more than happy to see it.
It had been too long.
A hundred thousand years.
Grandstar felt like it was already a miracle that none of them had gone mad after so long.

Su Yu had grown strong. He was also smart enough to collude with so many death sovereigns. Noting all those points, Grandstar smiled and said, “Go to Heavendoom first. I’ll contact the other guardians for you. How many cities are you prepared to take on?”
“All of them.”
Grandstar blanked out. “Are you sure?”
“Yes.” Su Yu declared indifferently, “I have grown a hundred times stronger than before.”
Strictly speaking, his combat strength had naturally not grown that much. But he had indeed grown to a point where he could easily defeat a hundred of the previous him. Thus, he wasn’t exactly wrong.
Grandstar inhaled deeply and said, “Was Blood Fire’s death related to you?”
“Yes. I killed him.” Su Yu smiled, “That’s not all. Of all the Invincibles who had entered the mansion, most were dead because of me apart from the humans and the ones friendly to humanity.”
Behind him, Liu Hong’s heart thumped madly.
Holy shit!
This guy had turned into a supreme walking disaster! No wonder. No wonder so many people had died this time, including Invincibles. So it was because of this guy! How crazy.
Even Grandstar was stunned. He said, “You…are too ruthless.”
What a butcher.
Grandstar felt like Su Yu had killed even more Invincibles than him in total.
Su Yu said, “Lord, I didn’t want to do so. But they kept attacking me. I didn’t even provoke them. For some reason, everyone wanted to kill me.”
Su Yu gnashed his teeth and said, “I didn’t provoke them first. Since they wanted to kill me, I wouldn’t spare them. There is no need to repay hostility with kindness.”
Grandstar exhaled slightly and asked, “Did you come out early to kill more?”

“It depends. If they stop causing trouble, I won’t mind a little bit of peace. But if they continue pushing me, I will kill more. I will kill enough to awe the entire Myriad Realms. I hope you can help me with that, Lord!”

Grandstar hesitated slightly and said, “You should ask our boss about this first. With his support, this won’t be an issue. Without his support, not even Heavendoom will be willing to go against him.”

Su Yu nodded in agreement. He needed to have a talk with the old turtle. He did not think that it would be that big of an issue so long as he avoided attracting too big of trouble for the ancient cities, such as a trouble capable of eliminating the ancient cities.
“Sure. I’ll be taking my leave, Lord…”
After a short pause, Su Yu said, “I will go out disguised as you. Lord, can you…hide your presence for a bit?”
“You…”

Grandstar resisted the urge to roll his eyes. The kid had grown both strong and gutsy enough to use his appearance as a disguise. The kid had only been in the Luminous Domain Mansion for a month, but he seemed to have changed completely.
What a monster!
“Sure. Let’s see if you can fool Heavendoom and the others with this disguise.”
“It won’t be that hard…”
Su Yu laughed. His confidence had also grown massively after this trip to the mansion.
Shortly after, a stone statue flew out of Grandstar City, attracting numerous gazes yet again.
An immortal sneered and said, “Su Yu is likely in the Luminous Domain Mansion. Just look at the guardians. They must be panicking. They are probably trying to make a plan to save him.”

Why would Grandstar move around so actively otherwise? As for the method he was using to leave the city, perhaps he was using some unknown secret trick to do so. They were more and more certain that Su Yu was in the mansion, and they were determined to kill him.
So many people had died this time. Who but a butcher like Su Yu would do something like this? They couldn’t spare him!
Meanwhile, Heavendoom was looking up with surprise. Another visit?
What was Grandstar doing? Why was he back so soon?
“Why are you here again, Grandstar? Are you deliberately doing this to provoke me?”
Heavendoom cursed repeatedly. This must be deliberate! Grandstar was showing off because he couldn’t leave! Was Grandstar longing to have a taste of his staff?
Damn it!
When Su Yu reached the inner room, Heavendoom blanked out slightly. Instantly, the look in his eyes turned ferocious, enough to cause even Su Yu to shiver. He hurriedly said, “Lord, it’s me!”
“Holy shit!”
Heavendoom blanked out. Su Yu!
Him?
Was this…a dream?
How could Su Yu be here?
Where did he come from?
Heavendoom started doubting reality.
